notes: ExtraTreesClassifier(200 trees, min_samples_leaf=20, seed 0) on standardized season-to-date features, then Platt-scaled: P = sigmoid(a*logit(forest) + b). Chosen on held-out top-1 accuracy over 8 seeds (CFB-BAKEOFF.md). The forest alone is under-confident because averaging compresses; Platt is monotone so it fixes the probabilities without touching the ranking. Every downstream constant here was re-measured against this fit.
